_comment: NCSES institution name -> IPEDS UNITID, for the surveys that publish names only.
HERD and the Federal Support Survey identify institutions by an NCSES house
style ('U. Pennsylvania', 'Johns Hopkins U.a') with no numeric identifier, so
joining them to IPEDS, GSS or completions requires resolving the name.
MOST NAMES NEED NO ENTRY HERE. The builder first normalises both sides --
expanding U./C./Inst./Tech./St., dropping of/the/at/and/in/campus/main, and
stripping the single trailing lowercase letter NCSES uses for footnotes -- and
accepts only an exact match on the resulting token set against exactly one
IPEDS institution. That resolves about 85% of rows unaided.
WHY THE REST ARE LISTED BY HAND RATHER THAN INFERRED. Subset matching was
tried and rejected: it maps 'Florida A&M U.' onto the University of Florida,
'Kutztown U. Pennsylvania' onto the University of Pennsylvania and 'State U.
New York, Maritime C.' onto New York University, because a short famous name
is a subset of many longer unrelated ones. Every entry below is a decision a
person made and can be checked, not a similarity score.
KIND SAYS WHAT THE ROW ACTUALLY COVERS, which matters for any per-student
ratio: campus_plus_affiliate rows fold in a hospital that enrols nobody,
multi_campus rows span units that report degrees separately, and system_office
rows have no students at all. Ambiguous names are deliberately absent: 'Lincoln
U.' could be the Pennsylvania, Missouri or California institution, so it stays
unmatched and is reported as such.

U. Maryland.note: College Park; HERD reports the flagship under the bare state name.

U. Michigan.note: Ann Arbor; Dearborn and Flint file separately.

U. Washington.note: Seattle; Bothell and Tacoma file separately.

Purdue U., West Lafayette.note: IPEDS calls it Purdue University-Main Campus.

Arizona State U..note: IPEDS splits ASU into Campus Immersion and Digital Immersion; NCSES reports one institution.

Rutgers, The State U. New Jersey.note: Federal Support reports Rutgers as one institution; IPEDS files New Brunswick, Newark and Camden separately.

U. Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus.note: IPEDS files Denver and Anschutz as one unit.

U. Colorado Denver.note: Same IPEDS unit as Anschutz; the two HERD rows must not be added to one profile twice.

CUNY, Graduate Center.note: CUNY Graduate School and University Center.

Tulane U..note: IPEDS name is Tulane University of Louisiana.

Indiana U.-Purdue U., Indianapolis.note: IUPUI split in 2024; the successor unit is Indiana University Indianapolis.

Embry-Riddle Aeronautical U..note: Daytona Beach is the research campus; Prescott and Worldwide file separately.

Pennsylvania State U., University Park a.note: Hershey has no separate IPEDS unit, so the NCSES aggregate and the IPEDS unit cover the same ground.

Texas A&M U., College Station and Health.note: The Health Science Center has no separate IPEDS unit.

Vanderbilt U. and Vanderbilt U. Medical.note: VUMC separated from the university in 2016 and is not an IPEDS institution; its R&D is included here but its staff and patients are not students.

Dartmouth C. and Dartmouth Hitchcock Med.note: DHMC is a separate non-IPEDS health system.

U. Nebraska, Lincoln and Medical Center.note: Lincoln and the Medical Center file separately in IPEDS.

Scripps Research Institute.note: Free-standing research institute; its graduate school does not report to IPEDS separately.

Uniformed Services U. of the Health Scie.note: Federal institution; does not report to IPEDS.

U. Maryland Center for Environmental Sci.note: Research centre of the University System of Maryland; no IPEDS unit.

CUNY, Graduate School of Public Health a.note: Reports within CUNY Graduate Center in IPEDS.

CUNY, Advanced Science Research Center.note: Research facility, not a degree-granting unit.
